zh.explain: 从小经商谋划都十分如意，财禄丰盈也从无苦恼。如果要只身去谋求事业，也必定是秀才出去成为状元，自会功成名就。
divination: 从小到大，顺顺利利，没有什么阻碍。
有意去追求的事情，都可顺心如意，获得成功。
zh.summary: 此卦自小为商之象。所祈求之事如果勤奋节俭地去做，可永保无忧无愁。

verse: A merchant since young built his experience
Earned fortunes and riches with little help.
If another path is now sought,
The scholar will return with honors.
interpretation: One has encountered few obstacles and troubles since young.
Fame and honor will be as desired if the business and affairs continue to be managed well.
meaning: A fortuitous life built on diligence and frugality.
en.explain: A merchant since young, thus he has lots of experience, amassing abundant wealth & fortune with little effort. If you wish to go into business, you will definitely be a scholar and return with honours and fame.
divination: Throughout your life, every undertaking has been smooth and without any obstacles. All your future undertakings will similarly be easily accomplished and successful as desired.

notes: 18 items (extra 迁徙搬家 / Migrating and moving house vs lot 1). zh key is 畜养动物 (not 家养动物); en key is 'Traveller' (not 'Travel').
